new.x: The Election Commission under Article 324 is an Indian provision not inspired by any foreign constitution; the others were borrowed.

new.x: The advisory jurisdiction of the Supreme Court under Article 143 was taken from Canada.

new.x: During a National Emergency, Fundamental Rights can be suspended except Articles 20 and 21.
